name: IBPS PO (Probationary Officer)
summary: National recruitment exam for Probationary Officer posts across public sector banks, conducted in Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university
Age 20-30 years as of the notified cut-off date, with relaxation for reserved categories
documents: Scanned photograph and signature per IBPS specification
fee: ₹850 for General/OBC/EWS candidates; ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates
process: Register and apply online, paying the fee via card/net banking/UPI
Appear for the Preliminary exam (objective, screening)
Qualified candidates appear for the Mains exam (objective + descriptive)
Shortlisted candidates attend a Personal Interview
Final allotment to a participating public sector bank based on merit and preference

faq.question: How many stages does IBPS PO have?
faq.answer: Three: Preliminary exam, Mains exam, and a Personal Interview. Prelims marks are qualifying only; the final merit list combines Mains and Interview scores.

faq.question: Which banks recruit through IBPS PO?
faq.answer: Most public sector banks (excluding SBI, which runs its own separate recruitment) participate in the common IBPS PO process for Probationary Officer/Management Trainee posts.
